simple: A SIEM for the security operations center (SOC) running on the Splunk data platform — in your own data center (Splunk Enterprise) or as a cloud service (Splunk Cloud Platform). Collects and normalizes logs from any source (2,800+ apps and add-ons on Splunkbase) and searches and analyzes them with the SPL query language. Comes with 1,700+ ready-made detections from Splunk Threat Research mapped to MITRE ATT&CK; Detection Studio helps test, deploy and monitor your own detections and see gaps in ATT&CK coverage. Risk-Based Alerting collects small signals per user or computer and raises a single alert once the risk adds up — up to 90% fewer alerts (vendor data). Built-in Threat Intelligence Management pulls in indicator feeds and matches them against events. Exposure Analytics continuously discovers computers, users, IP and MAC addresses in the logs and builds an up-to-date asset inventory from them. Investigation, case management and response plans are in one workspace; the AI assistant answers questions, writes queries and summarizes incidents (in the cloud, where available). Splunk SOAR automates response with ready-made playbooks: enriches alerts, blocks addresses, isolates computers through other security tools; playbooks can be built in plain language. Machine-learning UEBA learns the usual behavior of users and devices and spots deviations — compromised accounts, insiders. Automated Threat Analysis (Splunk Attack Analyzer, cloud only) opens suspicious files and links in an isolated environment on its own and extracts indicators of compromise. AI agents triage and explain alerts, break down malicious scripts line by line, and help write detections and playbooks.
